latest_apis.rationale: Consistently on the current generation, including several APIs shipped after most training data (@Service in v22, RESPONSE_INIT, @angular/ssr/node, BootstrapContext). Data loading uses ResolveFn resolvers instead of the now-stable resource()/httpResource(), but resolver + withComponentInputBinding is still the documented modern pattern (Angular docs/skill data-resolvers.md), so this is conservatism, not legacy.

findings.issue: @angular/forms is a runtime dependency but is never imported; all forms are native elements with manual handlers
findings.suggestion: Remove @angular/forms (and its weight) unless Signal Forms will be adopted for the filter controls

findings.issue: Every keystroke triggers router.navigate with queryParams merge, pushing a history entry per character, with no debounce
findings.suggestion: Debounce ~300ms (spec allows it) and/or pass replaceUrl: true while typing; consider making the URL q the single source of truth to drop the searchText signal + lastRequestedSearch bookkeeping

findings.issue: The catch → setTitle('Not found – Pokédex') → RESPONSE_INIT.status = 404 → return null block is duplicated in four resolvers (also ability.resolver.ts:50, move.resolver.ts, type.resolver.ts)
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared notFound() helper, or return RedirectCommand to a not-found route as the current docs recommend for resolver errors

findings.issue: effect() used to mirror the URL q input into a local signal plus a manual lastRequestedSearch field — state synchronization Angular's effects guidance says to avoid
findings.suggestion: Drive the input from the q input (computed) and navigate on input, removing the shadow signal and bookkeeping field

findings.issue: vitest and jsdom are installed and ng test is configured (angular.json test target) but the app contains zero tests
findings.suggestion: Either add a few unit tests for util.ts / pokedex-data.ts or drop the unused test tooling to keep the dependency surface honest

findings.issue: provideClientHydration(withHttpTransferCacheOptions({})) passes an empty options object, which is a no-op
findings.suggestion: Simplify to provideClientHydration(), or set the filter you actually want (e.g. includeRequestsWithAuthHeaders) explicitly

findings.issue: Runtime config read through globalThis cast to Record<string, any> with string index access
findings.suggestion: Declare a typed ambient window field (or use an InjectionToken factory with process.env only server-side and a typed global client-side) to keep the boundary typed

findings.issue: idFromUrl parses ids with a regex over the raw URL string
findings.suggestion: Use new URL(url).pathname segments for robustness; the regex works today but is another hand-rolled parser

summary: This is current-generation Angular: v22 with @Service, signal inputs, control-flow templates, SSR with route-level render modes and RESPONSE_INIT 404s, and data access cleanly centralized behind two services with typed API models. The forward-looking weaknesses are small — an unused @angular/forms dependency, test tooling with no tests, and some copy-pasted resolver/effects boilerplate that a shared helper would remove. It should age well through at least the next couple of majors.

apis.replacement: resource()/httpResource (stable since v22) is the newer primitive for component-level fetching, but resolvers are still documented as valid
Route-level title / ResolveTitle would be more idiomatic, but Title is not deprecated
